'''Chief Project Engineer''' was a position in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]], as well as [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. In both organizations, the position was held by the individual [[J. Johnston]].<ref name="ATATSpecPlate" />
